uqa121_098.roman_urdu: Pakistan ke poore mulk ke liye kanoon banane ka ikhtiyar kis ke paas hai?

uqa121_099.layperson_en: Can a provincial assembly set taxes on people in different jobs?
uqa121_099.roman_urdu: Kya provincial assembly logon par mukhtalif peshaon ke liye tax laga sakti hai?

uqa121_100.layperson_en: Do the taxes that the Provincial Assembly imposes count as income taxes?
uqa121_100.roman_urdu: Kya Provincial Assembly ke lagaye hue taxes ko income tax samjha jata hai?

uqa121_101.layperson_en: Who does the Governor have to swear an oath to before starting their duties?
uqa121_101.roman_urdu: Governor ko apni duties shuru karne se pehle kis ke samne oath lena hota hai?

uqa121_102.layperson_en: Can a temporary law (an ordinance) be kept in effect for a longer time than originally allowed?
uqa121_102.roman_urdu: Kya ordinance ko uski pehli muddat se zyada barhaya ja sakta hai?

uqa121_103.layperson_en: How long does an ordinance stay in effect before it is cancelled?
uqa121_103.roman_urdu: Ek ordinance kitni dair tak chalti hai pehle ke woh repealed ho jaye?

uqa121_104.layperson_en: When is the President allowed to issue an ordinance?
uqa121_104.roman_urdu: President kab ordinance issue kar sakta hai?

uqa121_105.layperson_en: Can a person be required to pay a tax that goes to a religion they don’t follow?
uqa121_105.roman_urdu: Kya koi insaan ko aisi tax dene par majboor kiya ja sakta hai jo uske mazhab ko support karti ho?

uqa121_106.layperson_en: If we miss a deadline that the Constitution sets, does that make the action invalid?
uqa121_106.roman_urdu: Agar Constitution ki deadline miss kar dein to kya woh action invalid ho jata hai?

uqa121_107.layperson_en: Does a law become ineffective if it isn’t completed within the time limit set by the Constitution?
uqa121_107.roman_urdu: Kya koi act bekaar ho jata hai agar woh Constitution ke mutabiq required time period ke andar complete na ho?

uqa121_108.layperson_en: What happens if a person who isn’t allowed takes part in a House’s proceedings?
uqa121_108.roman_urdu: Agar koi ghair haqdaar shakhs House ki proceedings mein shamil ho jaye to kya hoga?

uqa121_109.layperson_en: Can a legislative body keep operating even if some of its seats are vacant?
uqa121_109.roman_urdu: Kya House vacant seats ke bawajood kaam karte reh sakti hai?

uqa121_110.layperson_en: How long do the Commissioner and the members serve?
uqa121_110.roman_urdu: Commissioner aur members ka term kitna hota hai?

uqa121_111.layperson_en: What happens to the members after they've served for two and a half years?
uqa121_111.roman_urdu: Pehle do aur aadha saal ke baad members ko kya hota hai?
uqa121_111.keyword: members after two and a half years

uqa121_112.layperson_en: How is an empty position for a Commissioner or a member filled?
uqa121_112.roman_urdu: Commissioner ya member ki khali jagah kaise bharte hain?

uqa121_113.layperson_en: What will happen if a province has to spend extra money because the federal government gave it new powers and duties?
uqa121_113.roman_urdu: Agar koi province federation ki taraf se diye gaye powers aur duties ki wajah se extra kharcha uthaye, to kya hoga?
uqa121_113.keyword: province extra costs federation powers duties

uqa121_114.layperson_en: Can the central (federal) government hand over its duties to a provincial government?
uqa121_114.roman_urdu: Kya Federal Government apne functions Provincial Government ko assign kar sakti hai?

uqa121_115.layperson_en: Can you legally torture someone to get evidence from them?
uqa121_115.roman_urdu: Kya kisi se saboot hasil karne ke liye usko torture karna jaiz hai?

uqa121_116.layperson_en: Can the Supreme Court transfer a case from one High Court to another High Court?
uqa121_116.roman_urdu: Kya Supreme Court ek case ko ek High Court se doosri High Court mein transfer kar sakti hai?
uqa121_116.keyword: Supreme Court transfer case High Court

uqa121_117.layperson_en: When was the proclamation that ended Martial Law issued?
uqa121_117.roman_urdu: Martial Law khatam karne ka proclamation kab issue hua?

uqa121_118.layperson_en: What did S.R.O. No. 1278 (1) 85 leave out?
uqa121_118.roman_urdu: S.R.O. No. 1278 (1) 85 mein kya chhoda gaya?

uqa121_119.layperson_en: Is the President of Pakistan allowed to take another job that pays them for their work?
uqa121_119.roman_urdu: Kya Pakistan ka President koi aur paid job kar sakta hai?

uqa121_120.layperson_en: What happens to a member of Parliament or a Provincial Assembly if they are elected as President?
uqa121_120.roman_urdu: Agar koi MP ya Provincial Assembly ka member President ban jaye to uska kya hota hai?

dev23_d004.layperson_en: My motorcycle was stolen from outside my house. What crime is that?
dev23_d004.roman_urdu: Mere ghar ke bahar se meri motorcycle chori ho gayi. Ye kis jurm ke andar aata hai?
dev23_d004.urdu: میری گھر کے باہر سے میری موٹر سائیکل چوری ہو گئی۔ یہ کس جرم میں آتا ہے؟

dev23_d005.layperson_en: Someone stole my motorcycle from outside my house. What crime is that?
dev23_d005.roman_urdu: Kisi ne ghar ke bahar se meri motorcycle chori kar li, ye kaun sa jurm hai?
dev23_d005.urdu: کسی نے گھر کے باہر سے میری موٹر سائیکل چوری کر لی، یہ کون سا جرم ہے؟

dev23_d006.layperson_en: My brother got arrested. How can he get bail?
dev23_d006.roman_urdu: Mera bhai arrest ho gaya hai. Woh bail kaise le sakta hai?
dev23_d006.urdu: میرا بھائی گرفتار ہو گیا ہے۔ وہ ضمانت کیسے حاصل کر سکتا ہے؟

dev23_d007.layperson_en: My brother has been arrested. How can I get his bail?
dev23_d007.roman_urdu: Mere bhai ko giraftar kar liya gaya hai. Uski zamaanat kaise milegi?
dev23_d007.urdu: میرا بھائی گرفتار ہو گیا ہے۔ اس کی ضمانت کیسے حاصل کی جائے؟

dev23_d008.layperson_en: I haven't been arrested yet, but the police are threatening to arrest me on a false case. Can I get bail before I'm actually arrested?
dev23_d008.roman_urdu: Mujhe abhi tak giraftaar nahi kiya gaya, lekin police mujh par jhoota case bana kar giraftari ki dhamki de rahi hai. Kya main arrest se pehle bail le sakta/sakti hoon?
dev23_d008.urdu: مجھے ابھی تک گرفتار نہیں کیا گیا لیکن پولیس مجھے جھوٹے کیس میں گرفتار کرنے کی دھمکی دے رہی ہے۔ کیا میں گرفتاری سے پہلے ضمانت حاصل کر سکتا/سکتی ہوں؟

dev23_d010.layperson_en: The police station won't register my FIR. What should I do?
dev23_d010.roman_urdu: Police station meri FIR register karne se inkaar kar rahi hai. Main kya karoon?
dev23_d010.urdu: پولیس اسٹیشن میرا ایف آئی آر رجسٹر کرنے سے انکار کر رہی ہے۔ میں کیا کر سکتا ہوں؟

dev23_d019.layperson_en: I want to end my marriage, but my husband refuses to divorce me. How can I get a khula?
dev23_d019.roman_urdu: Mujhe shaadi khatam karni hai lekin mera husband divorce nahi de raha. Khula kaise le sakti hoon?
dev23_d019.urdu: میں اپنی شادی ختم کرنا چاہتی ہوں لیکن میرا شوہر طلاق نہیں دے رہا۔ خلع کیسے حاصل کر سکتی ہوں؟

dev23_d020.layperson_en: I want to end my marriage, but my husband won't give me a divorce. How can I get a khula?
dev23_d020.roman_urdu: Main shadi khatam karna chahti hoon lekin shohar talaq nahi de raha. Khula kaise loon?
dev23_d020.urdu: میں شادی ختم کرنا چاہتی ہوں لیکن شوہر طلاق نہیں دے رہا۔ خلع کیسے لوں؟

dev23_d021.layperson_en: After we split up, who will get custody of our 5‑year‑old son?
dev23_d021.roman_urdu: Humari alag hone ke baad, hamare 5 saal ke bete ki hifazat ka haq kaun ko milega?
dev23_d021.urdu: ہماری علیحدگی کے بعد، ہمارے 5 سالہ بیٹے کی سرپرستی کون حاصل کرے گا؟

dev23_d025.layperson_en: My neighbor sold his land to someone else without offering it to me first. Can I claim a right to buy it before anyone else?
dev23_d025.roman_urdu: Mera neighbor ne apni zameen kisi outsider ko bina mujhe pehle offer kiye bech di. Kya main pre-emption claim kar sakta hoon?
dev23_d025.urdu: میرا پڑوسی نے اپنی زمین کسی غیر ملکی کو بغیر مجھے پہلے پیش کیے بیچ دی۔ کیا میں پیشگی خرید کا حق دعویٰ کر سکتا ہوں؟

dev23_d031.layperson_en: What does section 379 of the Pakistan Penal Code say?
dev23_d031.roman_urdu: Pakistan Penal Code ke section 379 mein kya likha hai?
dev23_d031.urdu: پاکستان پینل کوڈ کے سیکشن 379 میں کیا لکھا ہے؟

dev23_c003.layperson_en: How is information recorded under Section 154 of the CrPC in a cognizable case?
dev23_c003.roman_urdu: Section 154 CrPC ke mutabiq cognizable case mein information kaise darj ki jati hai?
dev23_c003.urdu: سیکشن 154 سی آر پی سی کے تحت قابل گرفت کیس میں معلومات کیسے درج کی جاتی ہے؟

dev23_c004.layperson_en: Can bail be granted under Section 497 of the CrPC for a non‑bailable offence?
dev23_c004.roman_urdu: Kya Section 497 CrPC ke tehat non-bailable offence ke liye bail mil sakti hai?
dev23_c004.urdu: کیا سیکشن 497 سی آر پی سی کے تحت غیر قابل ضمانت جرم کے لیے ضمانت مل سکتی ہے؟

dev23_c007.layperson_en: What powers does a Justice of the Peace have according to Section 22-A of the Criminal Procedure Code?
dev23_c007.roman_urdu: Section 22-A CrPC ke mutabiq Justice of Peace ke kya powers hain?

dev23_c009.layperson_en: What does Section 379 of the Pakistan Penal Code say about theft?
dev23_c009.roman_urdu: PPC ki section 379 chori ke baare mein kya kehti hai?

dev23_c013.layperson_en: What does section 497 say about bail?
dev23_c013.roman_urdu: s. 497 bail ke mutalliq kya kehta hai?
dev23_c013.urdu: سیکشن 497 میں ضمانت کے بارے میں کیا کہا گیا ہے؟

dev23_c018.layperson_en: How can I get bail under Section 497 of the Criminal Procedure Code?
dev23_c018.roman_urdu: Section 497 CRPC ke tehat bail kaise milti hai?
dev23_c018.urdu: سیکشن 497 سی آر پی سی کے تحت بیل کیسے ملتی ہے؟

dev23_c020.layperson_en: What is anticipatory bail under Section 498 of the Criminal Procedure Code?
dev23_c020.roman_urdu: Section 498 CrPC ke mutabiq anticipatory bail kya hai?
dev23_c020.urdu: سیکشن 498 سی آر پی سی کے تحت anticipatory bail کیا ہے؟

dev23_l009.layperson_en: What authority does a Justice of the Peace have to arrest someone?
dev23_l009.roman_urdu: Justice of the Peace ko arrest karne ki kya powers hain?
dev23_l009.keyword: Justice of the Peace arrest powers
dev23_l009.urdu: جسٹس آف دی پیس کے پاس گرفتار کرنے کی کیا طاقتیں ہیں؟

dev23_v001.layperson_en: What punishment does theft get in Pakistan?
dev23_v001.roman_urdu: Pakistan mein chorri ki saza kya hai?
dev23_v001.urdu: پاکستان میں چوری کی سزا کیا ہے؟

dev23_m004.layperson_en: My bike was stolen from outside my house last night. What can I do legally?
dev23_m004.roman_urdu: Meri motorcycle kal raat mere ghar ke bahar se chori ho gayi. Ab mujhe kya karna chahiye?
dev23_m004.urdu: میری موٹر سائیکل کل رات گھر کے باہر سے چوری ہو گئی۔ مجھے قانونی طور پر کیا کرنا چاہیے؟
